G1_rules.note: Not a hardware designer's review. Blind run (ROADMAP 21.6): approved as produced, no rule edited. 6 rules kept, 4 rejected. The open question (overrun: which word is discarded; busy window) is left open, not answered. The README states no serial frame format (start, data, stop bits), so no rule covers the serial line encoding.

G2_contract.note: Not a hardware designer's review. Blind run (ROADMAP 21.6): approved as produced. 11 checks (4 assertions, 7 tests) cover the 6 rules. The contract assumes an 8N1 frame (start bit 0, 8 data bits LSB first, stop bit 1) and a bit period of 8*prescale cycles: the README does not state the frame format; this assumption is for the G4 reviewer.
